Entries.Text: Duplicate to Map, Move to Map and Paste (without the placement orb) keep objects at the same world position. Positions are relative to their map, so without this, an object put in another map keeps its coordinates and moves with that map: by a tile (256 m) between Elden Ring and Nightreign tiles, or by the map offset in games that have one. Shared by all three actions.

Rename the selected parts after their models, as the game names them: model_0000, model_0001 and so on. In Elden Ring and Nightreign, the number is the part's InstanceID, from 9000 upwards; in Armored Core VI, the part gets a free TypeIndex. Parts already named this way keep their names. When Referenced Rename is on, references are updated to the new names. You can undo this.
The selected parts are already named after their models.
